0022600133.text: Washington (2-2, 9th in the East, 3rd in the Southeast and 1 game back) visits Cleveland (2-1, 6th in the East, 2nd in the Central and 1 game back) for its fifth game of the season, with the Cavaliers riding a two-game winning streak. The Wizards are without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Cleveland has no unavailable players listed. The teams have not met yet this season, and Washington lost all four meetings with Cleveland in 2025-26, most recently a 130-117 defeat in Cleveland on April 12, 2026.
